mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usage_logs ( user_id, api_key_id, account_id, group_id, subscription_id, request_id, model, platform, requested_model, upstream_model, billing_mode, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_5m_tokens, cache_creation_1h_tokens, input_cost, output_cost, cache_creation_cost, cache_read_cost, cache_creation_5m_cost, cache_creation_1h_cost, total_cost, actual_cost, rate_multiplier, account_rate_multiplier, stream, duration_ms, first_token_ms, user_agent, ip_address, image_count, image_size, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{apiKeyId}, #{accountId}, #{groupId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{requestId}, #{model}, #{platform}, #{requestedModel}, #{upstreamModel}, #{billingMode}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{cacheCreationTokens}, #{cacheReadTokens}, #{cacheCreation5mTokens}, #{cacheCreation1hTokens}, #{inputCost}, #{outputCost}, #{cacheCreationCost}, #{cacheReadCost}, #{cacheCreation5mCost}, #{cacheCreation1hCost}, #{totalCost}, #{actualCost}, #{rateMultiplier}, #{accountRateMultiplier}, #{stream}, #{durationMs}, #{firstTokenMs}, #{userAgent}, #{ipAddress}, #{imageCount}, #{imageSize}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM usage_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_logs WHERE api_key_id = #{apiKeyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_logs WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM usage_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
